detailInk.prompt: Create one production-ready game UI asset: a tall, irregular ink-wash detail backdrop, portrait 1:2 aspect. REAL transparent RGBA outside the ink. Chinese xianxia sumi-e ink style. Deep charcoal-green BLACK ink body, almost opaque quiet center, enough broad uninterrupted dark space for pale item title, illustration and four paragraphs plus buttons. Entire silhouette fills 92% of canvas width and 94% height. Irregular asymmetrical brush edges, fine feathered diluted ink bleeding and very few tiny splashes along OUTSIDE perimeter. Top and bottom not rectangular, natural brush fray. Center must be dark ink, NOT white paper, NOT parchment, NOT cream, NO border, NO ornate frame, NO metallic gold, NO glyphs, NO lettering, NO icons, NO buttons, NO objects, NO scene. One isolated ink shape only, no cast shadow. Background must be completely transparent, not a checkerboard picture. This is a reusable black ink backdrop, not an illustration.

parcel.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game UI animation sprite sheet, TRUE transparent RGBA background. Create ONE 8-frame opening cloth parcel animation spritesheet in an exact 4-column by 2-row grid, wide 2:1 canvas. Each of the eight equally sized square cells shows the SAME parcel, SAME camera, SAME center, SAME scale and SAME cloth design, chronological reading left-to-right top row then bottom row. A traditional Chinese small tied travel bundle made from pale grey cloth, painted with expressive black Chinese ink brush outlines, grey wash, visible dry brush and flying white, elegant restrained shui-mo game style, 3/4 overhead view. Frame1 tied closed bundle, frame2 knot begins loosening, frame3 knot slips free, frame4 top cloth flap unfolds, frame5 side cloth flaps unfold, frame6 remaining flap opens, frame7 cloth mostly flat with small open hollow, frame8 empty fully open spread cloth with all four flaps, ready for items to emerge. Keep entire parcel within each cell, transparent generous padding. Cloth interiors can be pale near-white opaque for visibility on a dark 3D game scene. All eight parcel silhouettes isolated on actual transparent background, no paper rectangle or ground. No icons, no objects inside, no lettering, no numbers, no cell borders, no gold ornament, no neon, no colored cloth, no scenery. Coherent animation poses, not eight different bundles. The whole sheet is the single deliverable.

flow.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent game UI scrolling overlay texture. A narrow vertical Chinese ink wash flow texture, long 1:4 portrait canvas, grey-black diluted ink strands and soft wisps flowing downward with dry brush fibres and small floating flecks, very restrained delicate ink density, lots of real transparent negative space, highest opacity no more than 50 percent black. Top and bottom patterns seamless for vertical repetition, left and right edges fade gently to true transparency. No objects, no cloth, no lettering, no paper or rectangular background, no symbols, no neon. Only an abstract vertically seamless ink-water texture for a UI waterfall scroll edge.
